name: std::istream_iterator<T,CharT,Traits,Distance>::operator*, operator->
intro:
Returns a pointer or a reference to the current element.

The behavior is undefined if the iterator is end-of-stream iterator.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A pointer or a reference to the current element.

summary: Returns a pointer or a reference to the current element.
